notice: This is a design crosswalk for assisted diagnostic performance. Course descriptions show declared curriculum relevance; they do not verify delivered instruction, practice or participant exposure. Declared match names an explicit related outcome; Partial match means a material assessed relationship is not explicit. Neither status proves programme learning, full framework coverage or mastery.
demonstration: Select a framework domain or objective, inspect its lesson locator and teaching limit, then compare the exact question with the criterion descriptor. After a real diagnostic ends, use the reviewer workspace to attach a response location or quotation and a criterion judgement. A design link is an elicitation opportunity; reviewed participant evidence is a separate record.
teachingEvidenceNeeded: For each assessed relationship, attach the actual lesson/module and segment, a taught or practised example, delivery/cohort information, and relevant participant exposure. Confirm or narrow the assessment demand where the relationship was not taught; use untaught demands only as disclosed readiness probes. No compulsory learner AI/source log is introduced.

courseScope: These cases do not assess all twenty courses. Cybersecurity, specialist AI/DPI use, nation branding, IKS concept accuracy, live negotiation, communication and team performance require separate targeted evidence.
science: Evidence-Centered Design links intended inference, task and observed evidence. KLI guides candidate follow-up instruction after an evidenced gap; it does not certify taught coverage or knowledge-component mastery. Mayer's coherence and signaling guide compact, neutral presentation while retaining case constraints. Practice and D15 remain deferred.
transcriptLimit: The supplied Samvaad and IKS transcripts contain related discussions of duty, citizen empathy, institutional processes, learning from experience, delegation and public value. They add context, not verification of the full assessed reasoning sequences or participant exposure. Transcript examples do not override the fictional case's explicit authority and constraints.
